args.summary: Change record: deployed checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the unhealthy v2.3.1 release (error rate ~18%). v2.3.1 remained deployed since seq 3 and was marked unhealthy in production history. Deploy of v2.3.2 required change-manager approval because the version had no prior healthy production history; approval was granted. Post-deploy verification: all three regions report v2.3.2, service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. No further action anticipated; open only to document the change.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Both tasks are done.

**Deploy**
- Found checkout-api at **v2.3.1**, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Deployed **v2.3.2** to all three production regions. Since v2.3.2 had no prior healthy production history, it was routed for change-manager approval per policy, which was granted.
- Verified after deploy: all regions on v2.3.2, service **healthy**, error rate down to **0.02% (0.2%)**.

**Incident record**
- Opened **INC-0001**, SEV3, documenting the change: remediation of v2.3.1, the approval requirement and grant, and the post-deploy health verification.

One thing worth flagging: opening a SEV3 pages the on-call engineer. Since this was purely a documentation request for a successful change, that page is likely noise — you may want to resolve INC-0001 promptly or tell me if a records-only channel would have been a better fit next time. Also note v2.3.1-rc remains tracked in the release history as an unhealthy staging build, which is worth cleaning up separately.
